clue.text: To paint a verbal picture diets occasionally get 11 to enter church

indicators.note: occasionally means only every other letter of the word diets is used
to enter tells us one piece goes inside the abbreviation for church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
11-down is BONE, and a rib is an example of one

explanation.surface: Someone reports that dieters now and then end up at church.
explanation.walkthrough: In this puzzle a bare 11 stands for the answer to 11-down, a bone, so here it gives RIB, one kind of bone.
explanation.definitionFit: Describing something is painting a picture of it in words, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Plan to remove notices

parts.note: the prefix de- means to remove, as in de-ice
notices are signs; to de-sign is to remove them

explanation.surface: A scheme to take down the posters.
explanation.definitionFit: A design is a plan or scheme drawn up before something is made.

clue.text: Old runner in shabby cream vest

indicators.note: shabby suggests the words cream and vest are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: A former athlete is wearing a worn-out cream vest.
explanation.walkthrough: Steve Cram is a British middle-distance runner, a 1980s world champion at 1500 metres.
explanation.definitionFit: He is a retired middle-distance athlete, so a runner from the past.

clue.text: Force prophet to climb round submerged rocks

indicators.note: round means the reversed prophet wraps around the force letter
to climb, in a down clue, means the prophet word goes upwards, read backwards

parts.note: a seer is a prophet
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: A prophet is forced to climb around rocks under the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Reefs are ridges of rock or coral lying just below the water surface.

clue.text: Commentated online as mob finally felled trees

indicators.note: finally means only the last letter of mob is used

parts.note: to log is to cut down trees

explanation.surface: An online pundit reports that the mob at last cut the trees down.
explanation.definitionFit: Blogging is writing commentary in an online journal.

clue.text: In the US, prosecute junior reporter's "topless" smear

parts.note: in the US a prosecutor is a DA, a district attorney, so to prosecute is to be DA

indicators.note: topless means the junior reporter's word loses its first letter

parts.note: a cub is a junior newspaper reporter

explanation.surface: An American lawyer goes after a young journalist for a sleazy, revealing story.
explanation.walkthrough: The quote marks round topless hint that it is not about clothing: it removes the top letter of CUB.
explanation.definitionFit: To bedaub is to smear or daub something messily, so the verb is a synonym.

clue.text: List two points, worried after twice hesitating

indicators.note: after places the worried word behind the hesitations

parts.note: E and N are two compass points, east and north
um is one sound of hesitation
er is a second sound of hesitation
ate, as in 'what's eating you', means worried

explanation.surface: Someone lists two points, anxious after umming and erring.
explanation.definitionFit: To enumerate is to name things one by one, as in a list.

clue.text: A group of 11s drank less after removing a couple of layers of clothing

definitions.note: 11 is BONE (11-down), so a group of bones

indicators.text: removing a couple of layers of clothing
indicators.note: the two words are treated as a body dressed in two layers, so two letters are stripped from each end, leaving what sits inside

explanation.surface: Someone drank less after peeling off a couple of layers.
explanation.walkthrough: The outer two letters at each end of DRANKLESS, DR and SS, are taken off.
explanation.definitionFit: The ankle joint is made of a cluster of small bones, the tarsals.

clue.text: Beckham is uncomfortable, only OK after emptying bladder

indicators.note: after says the rearranged letters follow the emptied bladder
emptying means remove the inside of bladder, leaving its first and last letters
uncomfortable signals that only and OK are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: Beckham is in discomfort, only fine once he has relieved himself.
explanation.walkthrough: Brooklyn Beckham is the eldest son of footballer David Beckham.
explanation.definitionFit: The footballer's eldest son bears this name, so the surname stands for him.

clue.text: John perhaps takes note after one leaves runner a set of 11s

indicators.note: after places the singer piece behind the shortened runner
leaves means the numeral-like letter for one departs from the runner word

parts.note: a ski is a runner on snow, as on a sledge
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: takes means the singer's name holds the musical note inside it

parts.note: Elton John is an example of someone called John
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A runner leaves while Elton John picks up a note, apparently a sports and music story.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 is BONE (11-down), so a set of 11s is a full set of bones. ELTON takes E after its L to make ELETON.
explanation.definitionFit: A skeleton is the whole framework of bones in a body.

clue.text: Betrayed husband swaps rings for old bird

indicators.note: swaps signals that one stretch of the husband word is exchanged
for says which letters come in place of the others

parts.note: a cuckold is a man whose wife has been unfaithful
two rings look like the letters O O

explanation.surface: A wronged husband trades his wedding rings for an old bird, a new partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old bird' looks like one phrase, but old is the letters taken out of CUCKOLD and bird alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The cuckoo is a bird famous for laying its eggs in other birds' nests.

clue.text: Something to pick with someone good in France and Spain

parts.note: bon is French for good
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A grievance with a good person in France and Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a bone to pick with a person is an idiom for having a complaint against them.

clue.text: Prediction worrying you before mysterious process ends

indicators.note: ends means take the final letter of each of the five words before it

explanation.surface: A forecast that frets you ahead of some mysterious procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: A guess is an estimate or forecast made without certain knowledge.

clue.text: Good coke one's arranged in a curve

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of coke and one's are put in a new order

parts.note: one's here is read as ones, giving its S as a letter

explanation.surface: A good piece of coke is shaped into a curve.
explanation.definitionFit: A gooseneck is a pipe or fitting bent into a curve like the neck of a goose.

clue.text: Expert journalist bowed

parts.note: arch can mean cunning or masterly, as in an arch manipulator
ED is an editor, a senior journalist

explanation.surface: A skilled reporter takes a bow.
explanation.walkthrough: Bowed looks like a past-tense verb about bowing to someone; here it means curved.
explanation.definitionFit: Something arched is curved like a bow or an arch.

clue.text: Greeting Moira, upset about silence at bombsite

parts.note: hi is a greeting

indicators.note: about means the rearranged name goes around the call for silence
upset means the letters of Moira are tipped into a new order

parts.note: sh is the call for silence

explanation.surface: Hello to Moira, who is distressed about the hush at a bombed site.
explanation.definitionFit: Hiroshima was the Japanese city destroyed by the first atomic bomb used in war, in 1945.

clue.text: I agree old cat is disturbed by empty litter-tray

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: is disturbed means the letters of cat are thrown into a new order
empty means remove the inside, leaving the first and last letters of litter-tray

explanation.surface: Someone agrees that the elderly cat was upset by finding its litter tray bare.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'exactly' expresses complete agreement with what was just said.

clue.text: Barrels upside-down in river are experimental vessels

indicators.note: in means the overturned barrels sit inside the river's name

parts.note: the Tees is a river in north-east England

indicators.note: upside-down, in a down clue, means the barrels word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: butts are large barrels

explanation.surface: Overturned barrels in a river turn out to be lab equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Test tubes are thin glass vessels used for laboratory experiments.

clue.text: Joint quiet before loud brawl with monarch

indicators.note: before places the quiet piece ahead of the rest

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet

indicators.note: a brawl is a messy fight, so the letters of loud are thrown about

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A hush comes before a noisy fight involving the king.
explanation.definitionFit: The shoulder is the joint where the arm meets the body.

clue.text: 11's bad smell certain to return

definitions.note: 11 is BONE (11-down); the 's means 'is', so the definition reads 'a bone is'

parts.note: hum is British slang for a bad smell

indicators.note: to return means the word for certain is read backwards

parts.note: sure means certain

explanation.surface: A bone gives off a nasty smell that is sure to come back.
explanation.definitionFit: The humerus is the long bone of the upper arm.

clue.text: 11 miss final point in Polish

indicators.note: miss means leave out the compass letter from the polish word

parts.note: to shine is to polish
E, east, is taken as the point at the end

explanation.surface: A bone misses the decisive point in a Polish match.
explanation.walkthrough: Polish looks like the nationality; it is the verb to polish.
explanation.definitionFit: The shin is the front of the leg over the shinbone, the tibia.

clue.text: Jenny and Henry in the water by the ship

indicators.note: in means the Henry letter sits inside the word for the water

parts.note: the sea is the water
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
SS stands for steamship, used before ship names

explanation.surface: Jenny and Henry are swimming beside the boat.
explanation.walkthrough: Jenny and Henry look like two people; Jenny is the definition and Henry the unit H.
explanation.definitionFit: A jenny is a female donkey, which is also called by this hyphenated term.

clue.text: Succulent forms of gold to talk up

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, means the pieces are read upwards, backwards

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
Au is the chemical symbol for gold
gas is idle talk

explanation.surface: Golden forms come to chat.
explanation.definitionFit: The saguaro is a giant cactus, a succulent plant of the Arizona desert.

clue.text: Humble character overwhelmed by noxious gas makes piping noises

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means the character is engulfed inside the gas letters

parts.note: CS gas is a tear gas
Uriah Heep in Dickens's David Copperfield constantly claims to be humble

explanation.surface: A meek man overcome by fumes starts squeaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Small birds cheep, making short high-pitched piping calls.

clue.text: Revealing the identity of a French male making demands

parts.note: un is the French word for a
asking means making requests or demands

explanation.surface: A demanding Frenchman exposes who somebody really is.
explanation.definitionFit: Unmasking a person means exposing who they truly are, as if pulling off a disguise.

clue.text: Enterprising XIs rudely try and attract top cricket club's attention?

definitions.note: Dr McCoy of the starship Enterprise is nicknamed Bones; XI is 11, the bone of 11-down

parts.note: the MCC, Marylebone Cricket Club, is the leading English cricket club
oy is a rude shout to get someone's attention

explanation.surface: Bold cricket teams shout rudely to catch the attention of the MCC.
explanation.walkthrough: Enterprising and XIs look like keen cricket teams; they point to the Star Trek doctor, 'Bones'. Oy is shouted after the club, so it comes second.
explanation.definitionFit: The doctor on the starship Enterprise in Star Trek is called 'Bones', a pun on 11s.

clue.text: Perhaps Persian children have a little song

parts.note: a Persian is a breed of cat, so it is an example

explanation.surface: Persian children, perhaps, sing a short tune.
explanation.walkthrough: Persian looks like a nationality describing the children; it is the cat breed.
explanation.definitionFit: A catch is a short round, a little song for several voices singing in turn.

clue.text: First of 11 fish found above unknown old manuscript

indicators.note: found above, in a down clue, puts the fish on top of the other letters

parts.note: the cod is a fish
11 spelt out is eleven, whose first letter is E
X is the classic algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A fish found over an unknown quantity, in an ancient text.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 here is read as the word eleven, not the bone, so its first letter is E.
explanation.definitionFit: A codex is an ancient manuscript bound as a book rather than a scroll.

clue.text: TV presenter's drawback is fakery

parts.note: Dec is Declan Donnelly of the British TV presenting duo Ant and Dec
split as draw plus back: a draw is a tie, and back means read it the other way round

explanation.surface: A TV host's weakness turns out to be pretending.
explanation.walkthrough: Drawback looks like one word meaning flaw; it splits into draw (TIE) plus back, which turns it to EIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Deceit is deception or trickery, closely matching fakery.

clue.text: 11 injected nuts with nitrogen — one nearly exploded!

indicators.note: injected means the nitrogen symbol is pushed inside the word for nuts

parts.note: nuts means mad
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: nearly means drop the last letter of the word for exploded

parts.note: blew, as in blew up, means exploded

explanation.surface: A bone was injected with nitrogen-laced nuts, and someone nearly blew up.
explanation.definitionFit: The mandible is the jawbone, the lower jaw.

clue.text: A fashionable company (bar any mishap)

indicators.note: a mishap is an accident, so the letters of bar and any are knocked about

explanation.surface: A stylish firm, provided nothing goes wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Ray-Ban is a fashion brand known for its sunglasses.

clue.text: 11 ways to follow 2's rival bringing lives together

indicators.note: to follow means these pieces come after the rival's name

parts.note: Seb Coe was the great rival of runner Steve Cram (2-down)
XI is 11 in Roman numerals
St is short for street, a way, so ways gives two of them

explanation.surface: A runner's old rival finds eleven routes that bring lives together.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 is the numeral here, not the bone it means elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that coexists lives alongside something else at the same time.
